_comment: Synthetic slots for Story 12.2's v1 rule tests. Not client data. Times are minutes after local midnight; 2026-11-01 is a Sunday (the DST change), 2026-11-02 a Monday, 2026-11-03 a Tuesday.

cases.name: crew-day-limits passes inside the crew day
crew-day-limits fails a start before the earliest start
cases.reason: starts at 05:30, before the crew day's earliest start of 06:00

cases.name: crew-day-limits fails a finish after the latest finish
cases.reason: finishes at 23:15, after the crew day's latest finish of 23:00

cases.name: day-of-week passes on an allowed day
cases.reason: Monday is one of the customer's days

cases.name: day-of-week fails on a day the customer does not allow
cases.reason: the customer's days are Monday, Wednesday or Sunday, not Tuesday

cases.name: time-of-day passes a start inside the window
cases.reason: starts at 10:00, inside the customer's window (08:00 to before 12:00)

cases.name: time-of-day fails a start at the window's end
cases.reason: starts at 12:00, outside the customer's window (08:00 to before 12:00)

cases.name: preferred-crew passes on the preferred crew
cases.reason: on crew c1, the preferred crew

cases.name: preferred-crew fails on another crew
cases.reason: on crew c2, not the preferred crew c1

cases.name: aim-finish passes a finish at the aim-finish time
cases.reason: finishes at 18:00, by the aim-finish time of 18:00

cases.name: aim-finish fails a finish past the aim-finish time
cases.reason: finishes at 18:40, 40 minutes past the aim-finish time of 18:00
